content:
maria-sales: FYI — AcmeHealth opened a request: they want "open-llama-3-13b" added to hosted catalog and pinned to v2025-02 in eu-central-1 only. Ticket ACME-422 attached.

maya-support: Support ticket snippet:
```
customer: AcmeHealth
ask: Add open-llama-3-13b v2025-02 to hosted catalog
regions: eu-central-1 only
constraints: no data residency transfer, HIPAA-ish compliance, prefer fp16 or int8 quant
priority: medium (trialing)
```

alex-product: Qs: 1) Is v2025-02 a reproducible build we can pin? 2) Any perf regressions vs our 13B profiles?

riley-ml: v2025-02 is tokenization fix + weight reorder, should be reproducible. Might need updated fused-attn for longer contexts. I'll validate.

dave-infra: EU-only is doable but need to check memory / SKUs. Native fp32 13B ~48GB VRAM. For fp16 quant we'll need a quantized build and perf testing.

jen-sec: HIPAA-ish note: For hosted EU we can support if audit logging + controls are in place. No cross-region fallback by default; require sign-off.

alex-product: Acceptance criteria proposal:
- model binary v2025-02 uploaded to S3 with checksum
- perf profile in eu-central-1 (p95 < 800ms for 512 tokens)
- quantized variant (fp16/int8) with cost delta
- security/policy checklist signed
- rollout: internal canary -> limited customer -> wide

maria-sales: Customer requests ASAP, ideally within 3 weeks.

riley-ml: Eval plan:
- correctness vs prompt suite (10k prompts)
- perf vs v2024-12
- memory + kvcache benchmarks

maya-support: Added to intake tracker: https://redwood.internal/requests/ACME-422

alex-product: Propose priority P2; bump to P1 if sales sees revenue within 8 weeks.

maria-sales: Sales says high-propensity trial. Keep P2 but tag 'revenue upsell potential'.

dave-infra: Can run perf tests in eu-central in ~10 business days, need region-scoped pin support in CI and a rollout flag to prevent cross-region spill.

alex-product: I'll add catalog schema fields: "region_pin": ["eu-central-1"], "fallback_policy": "disabled_by_default". Will open PR + docs.

riley-ml: ETA: 6 biz days for correctness, 8 for perf/quant runs.

jen-sec: I'll schedule 30-min review once artifacts ready.

alex-product: Triage -> backlog. Create product task PROD-1347 with checklist; assignees: Riley (ML), Dave (Infra), Jen (Security), Maya (Support). Target 3-week delivery but flexible.

deploy-bot: Created ticket PROD-1347: "Add open-llama-3-13b v2025-02 (EU-only pin)" assigned to alex-product. https://redwood.internal/tasks/PROD-1347 :white_check_mark:

maya-support: I'll update customer weekly. Will escalate here if priority changes.

alex-product: Keeping P2 with upsell tag. Will post PR link when available.
